@graph.description: Sauna delivery and installation across Ontario for $1,750, or delivery only to a local depot for $450. Cold plunges, heaters and accessories delivered to your door.

blocks.html: Choose full delivery and installation by our team, anywhere in Ontario or British Columbia, or delivery only by freight. Cold plunges, heaters and accessories come right to your door.

blocks.html: Our team delivers your sauna anywhere in Ontario, unloads it, and installs it. If you buy a heater with your sauna, it is included.
blocks.text: Our team delivers your sauna anywhere in Ontario, unloads it, and installs it. If you buy a heater with your sauna, it is included.

blocks.html: Your sauna ships by freight to a local depot in Ontario. Freight carriers can’t unload large sauna crates, so you’ll need to unload it by hand with enough helpers, or arrange equipment such as a forklift or skid steer. Please return the carrier’s calls promptly to book your pickup.

blocks.html: Saunas in BC and the rest of Canada
blocks.text: Saunas in BC and the rest of Canada

blocks.html: We install in British Columbia too. Delivery and installation in BC, or delivery anywhere else in Canada, is quoted for your location, and we confirm the cost with you before anything ships. For delivery only, the same unloading rules apply.
blocks.text: We install in British Columbia too. Delivery and installation in BC, or delivery anywhere else in Canada, is quoted for your location, and we confirm the cost with you before anything ships. For delivery only, the same unloading rules apply.

blocks.html: Cold plunges, heaters and accessories are delivered right to your door. Delivery is quoted for your location, and in-stock items can be picked up free at our showroom in Schomberg, by appointment.
blocks.text: Cold plunges, heaters and accessories are delivered right to your door. Delivery is quoted for your location, and in-stock items can be picked up free at our showroom in Schomberg, by appointment.

blocks.html: Saunas ship in crates from 6 to 14 feet long, weighing roughly 800 to 1,600 lbs. For installation we need a clear, safe path to the install spot and a level, prepared base. We go over your site with you when we quote.
blocks.text: Saunas ship in crates from 6 to 14 feet long, weighing roughly 800 to 1,600 lbs. For installation we need a clear, safe path to the install spot and a level, prepared base. We go over your site with you when we quote.

blocks.html: Check your delivery before signing. If a crate looks damaged, accept it, take photos, and write “Crate arrived damaged – possible hidden damage” on the bill of lading. Then contact us right away.
blocks.text: Check your delivery before signing. If a crate looks damaged, accept it, take photos, and write “Crate arrived damaged – possible hidden damage” on the bill of lading. Then contact us right away.

blocks.html: Report shortages, defects or shipping errors within 14 days of delivery. After that, issues are handled through the warranty.
blocks.text: Report shortages, defects or shipping errors within 14 days of delivery. After that, issues are handled through the warranty.

blocks.html: Talk to a real person. Visit our showroom at 17380 Highway 27, Schomberg, by appointment.
